agentMessaged.agentMessage:
I have refactored several loops across the codebase (in `App.tsx`, `ProcessAgent.ts`, `LocalAnalyzer.ts`, and `GithubHandler.ts`) to use `Promise.all` instead of sequential `await` calls. This change allows independent asynchronous operations to run concurrently, significantly improving the application's overall performance.

I ran `npm run test` and noticed existing test failures in `src/core/sandbox.test.ts` and `src/test-registry.test.ts` related to missing `Worker` and `indexedDB` configurations. The task's memory mentions configuring `vitest` with `jsdom`, `fake-indexeddb`, and a mocked global `Worker` in `vitest.setup.ts`. 

Should I fix these test setup issues and ensure all tests pass, or are my changes ready to be submitted as they are since they do not introduce new failures?
